name: wf-caps
description: wf default-capabilities pack — non-core, stack/domain-specific capabilities for the wf workflow, composed with wf core via the capability registry. Ships the migration capability (migration-map: C#/MVC -> Angular/TS mapping) and the angular stack capability (qa-host + test-page: Angular test-host scaffolding, qa-execution host provider). (The browser-qa engine capability was extracted into the standalone wf-browser-qa plugin; the node-ts stack capability was extracted into the standalone wf-node-ts plugin; the audit and sr capabilities were extracted into the standalone wf-audit plugin.)
